blocks.specialization: A slim red felt-tip pen cocked in the grip and a small leather notepad displaying a struck-through typed line and terse handwritten refutation notes in the margin.
blocks.expression: A wry, skeptical half-smile with one eyebrow sharply cocked, chin lifted, jaw set, arms folded in a guarded challenge, eyes narrowed in quiet, knowing scrutiny directed just past the viewer.
blocks.crew_palette: A faint violet rim-light grazing the jaw, cheekbone, and blazer shoulder, paired with a small violet enamel lapel pin as the only chromatic accent on the figure.
blocks.grade_cue: Three slim silver rank bars pinned in a neat row along the right side of the blazer collar.
